input.issue: I notice that people I assigned the test in October of 2025 have not received new tests. How long do the tests stay active in the system.
input.subject: Test Active in the system

triage.reasoning: Standard product FAQ about test settings.

grounded.response:
Tests in HackerRank remain active unless an expiration date is set. To set an expiration date, go to the test's **Settings > General**, and modify the **Start date & time** and **End date & time** in the **Test Expiration Time** section. After the test expires, invited candidates cannot access the test, and the **Invite** button is disabled.

You can also define how long a test invitation remains active by setting an expiry date when inviting candidates.
